title: Inkwell
features: Ebook library with EPUB reading (pagination, table of contents, font size, themes)
Audiobook streaming with background playback, chapters, speed and sleep timer
User accounts, bookmarks, highlights and favourites
Free and premium membership with paywall and gated titles
CMS-driven content (new titles and daily pieces without app release)

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 4 tabs in this exact order. Active tab icon + label in accentFill with a small pill indicator; inactive in text.tertiary. A mini player (cover thumb, title, play/pause) sits directly above the tab bar on Today, Library and Search when audio is loaded.

sharedComponents.statusBar: iOS status bar, 59px top inset kept clear.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, accentFill bg, white label 16/600, pressed = accentPressed, disabled = 40% opacity. Secondary: pill, white bg, 1.5px borderStrong outline, text.primary label. Input: 12px radius, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accent ring, error = danger border + caption. Card: 20px radius, white, soft shadow. Chip: pill 13/600, accentTint fill with accentFill text; selected = accentFill fill with white text. Premium badge: small pill, support tint with dark text, crown icon.

type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)

designSystem.a11y: white labels only on accentFill; bright accent for large fills/icons; tap targets >= 44pt

warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
danger text on its tint and on surface
